//: FIP: diameter 6.35-6.77 cm, mass 56.0-59.4 g, 2.54 m drop must bounce 135-145 cm (altitude ball 122-135 cm above 1000 m). dragCoefficient: free-flight C_D of new felt balls, 0.507 +- 0.024 at 14-30 m/s whatever the spin (Cross & Lindsey, 128 shots; wind tunnels read 15-20% high). spinDecayPerM: k in dw/dt = -k w v (spin decay is linear in spin x speed, James & Haake 2008); k estimated from golf's ~4%/s at 60 m/s and felt balls decaying about six times faster, so a ball loses about 0.5% of its spin per metre flown at sea level (scaled by air density). wear: the match ball's nap fluffs up with every impact (each counts (normal speed / 15 m/s)^2, at most 3), reaching its used state over fluffImpacts. dragFluff: used balls fly with 4.1% more drag than new ones (Hawk-Eye, 9,200 Davis Cup first serves: C_D 0.603 used vs 0.579 new); in AI doubles a point is about 15 weighted impacts, so the nap is fluffed up within the first set. muGain, eGain: padel balls after 666 machine strokes (IBV for Testfakta 2023, 8 brands) gripped the court 2-7% more (mean 4.4%) and bounced 0.7-2.8% higher in the drop test (about +1% restitution), softer and slower off the court only through the friction. Nobody has measured pressure loss within a match (FIP only caps the drop-test change after 9 simulated games at 4 cm), so the ball doesn't go flat during a match.

altitude.name: Altitude ball (lower pressure, for venues above 1000 m)
